subject: A north Indian village in flood during the monsoon. Brown water covers the fields to the horizon and laps at the plinths of mud houses. Villagers wade carrying children and brass pots on their heads; a family sits on a thatched roof with a goat; two men pole a country boat loaded with bundles. A drowned tree and the tops of a millet crop show above the water. Heavy grey-blue monsoon sky with slanting rain, and a single white egret. Figures small against the water, the composition ordered in flat horizontal bands.
